recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-column newspaper layout featuring a large, high-contrast halftone photograph of a crowd scene centered on a blonde female figure, framed by dense justified text and bold, condensed headlines on aged, yellowed newsprint.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black and white photography against aged cream paper.
Bold red headline overlaying the top edge of the central image.
Dense, multi-column justified serif text framing a central visual anchor.
Visible halftone dot patterns and ink bleed consistent with 20th-century printing.
coreInvariants: Halftone screen effect on all photographic elements.
High-contrast lighting in the central image (paparazzi flash style).

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central large rectangular image occupies 60% of the frame, surrounded by narrow text columns.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central blonde figure in the photograph, highlighted by bright flash lighting.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top masthead down to the red headline, into the central photo, then outward to the surrounding text columns.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the layout is dense and 'busy', typical of tabloid journalism.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the photo; low saturation overall except for the single red accent.

letterConstructionRules: Masthead uses high-contrast modern serifs with sharp terminals.
Main headline uses ultra-compressed, heavy-weight sans-serif.
Body text uses classic news-serif with tight leading.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Headline characters are vertically elongated with minimal tracking.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for authority paired with aggressive condensed sans-serif for urgency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, condensed nature of the red headline.
Provides the classic newspaper serif aesthetic for masthead and body.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an aged, yellowed newsprint background with a 3-column grid. In the center, place a large rectangular black and white photo with a heavy halftone dot pattern. The photo should depict a crowded 1980s nightlife scene with high-contrast flash lighting. Add thin black horizontal lines above and below the photo area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large serif masthead at the very top. Place an ultra-condensed red sans-serif headline across the top edge of the central photo. Fill the side columns with justified serif body text, including small sub-headlines in bold serif.

verificationChecks: Is the paper texture visibly aged and non-white?
Does the central photo have a visible halftone dot texture?
Is the red headline ultra-condensed and bold?
Is the body text justified within narrow columns?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern fonts like Arial or Calibri are used.
Check that the red headline is perfectly legible against the photo background.
Verify the halftone effect is consistent across all photographic elements.
Confirm the layout feels crowded and information-dense.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Aged Newsprint Texture] + [3-Column Editorial Grid] + [Halftone Paparazzi Photo] + [Ultra-Condensed Red Headline] + [High-Contrast Serif Masthead].
